Geaux Ride Thursday Night Community Ride

Baton Rouge, LA · Downtown · Social · Cruiser

Geaux Ride Thursday Night Community Ride is a social and cruiser group ride in Baton Rouge, LA. It rolls every Thursday at 7:45 pm from Geaux Ride. Pace: slow, family friendly. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow, family friendly. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @geauxridebtr the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Geaux Ride Thursday Night Community Ride group ride

A free Thursday night cruise through downtown Baton Rouge with lights and music. Bring your own bike or rent one from Geaux Ride. Family friendly. Street parking or the garage at 3rd and Main.
